stories.title: Gli Houthi all’Italia: “Non siamo in guerra con voi, ma i vostri aerei sono lì”. Riad sotto attacco

en.title: Houthis to Italy: "We are not at war with you, but your aircraft are there". Riyadh under attack
en.summary: Houthi rebels attacked Saudi Arabia's capital, with fire and smoke reported near the airport. The group told Italy it is not in conflict with the country but questioned the presence of Italian aircraft in the region.

stories.title: Ritrovate vicino casa le due sorelline scomparse

en.title: Two missing sisters found near home
en.summary: Two sisters, ages 12 and 8, who disappeared on Friday were found locked inside a nearby shop they both knew. The shop owner was questioned.

stories.title: Attacco Houthi su Riad, avvertono Roma: “Non in guerra con voi, ma con i jet sostenete i sauditi”

en.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh, warning Rome: "Not at war with you, but you support Saudis with jets"
en.summary: Yemeni rebel spokesperson stated the group has no conflict with Italy but questioned why Italian aircraft are in Saudi Arabia. A missile strike hit the capital's airport as tensions escalated.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata a Roma, il video choc del 13enne che prepara l'assalto in bagno e poi affonda il colpo

en.title: Teacher stabbed in Rome, shocking video of 13-year-old preparing assault in bathroom and striking
en.summary: Video footage showed a 13-year-old student preparing an attack in a school bathroom before assaulting his teacher in class in Rome on Friday. Another student intervened to stop the assault.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata, si indaga sulla rete del 13enne:”Arruolato dai gruppi suprematisti”

en.title: Teacher stabbed, investigation into 13-year-old's network: 'Recruited by supremacist groups'
en.summary: A 13-year-old recorded a video call of an attack on teacher Isabella Marsilio. A juvenile court has opened an inquiry to assess educational measures for the suspect.

stories.title: Ritrovate le due sorelline scomparse a Caltanissetta: erano vicino a casa, stanno bene

en.title: Two missing sisters found near Caltanissetta: they are safe
en.summary: Two young girls who disappeared in Caltanissetta were located in a shop and are in good condition. The shop has been seized by authorities.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata dal 13enne, il marito: "Lei vorrebbe abbracciarlo". Si indaga sui cellulari

en.title: Teacher stabbed by 13-year-old, husband says: "She would like to embrace him". Investigation into phones underway
en.summary: A teacher was stabbed three times following pepper spray use by a 13-year-old attacker. Investigators are examining mobile devices and online communications related to an alleged livestreamed assault on Telegram.

stories.title: Alta tensione tra Riad e le milizie Houthi: "Non siamo in guerra con l'Italia"

en.title: High tension between Riyadh and Houthi militias: 'We are not at war with Italy'
en.summary: Two explosions occurred in Saudi Arabia as Iran-backed Yemeni militias sought to control the Red Sea. An Italian Eurofighter was damaged in an attack on a Saudi base two days prior.

stories.title: Il giallo delle due sorelline scomparse e ritrovate 21 ore dopo in un negozio

en.title: Mystery of two missing sisters found 21 hours later in a shop
en.summary: Two girls were discovered in a store owned by a Chinese woman who is friends with their father. Prosecutors are investigating unclear circumstances and a possible kidnapping charge.

stories.title: I capolavori di Sandro Mazzola, morto a 83 anni: i dieci migliori gol con la sua Inter

en.title: The masterpieces of Sandro Mazzola, died at 83: his ten best goals with Inter
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, a legendary Inter player, has passed away at age 83. The outlet highlights his ten greatest goals scored for the club.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola, il figlio del Grande Torino diventato icona dell’Inter

en.title: Sandro Mazzola, son of Grande Torino who became an Inter icon
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, son of Valentino Mazzola, won four Serie A titles and two European Cups during 17 seasons with Inter. He also won the 1968 European Championship with Italy.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, news. Houthi: “Nel raid colpiti obiettivi sensibili di Riad e siti petroliferi”

en.title: War in Iran, news. Houthis: "Sensitive Riyadh targets and oil sites hit in raid"
en.summary: Yemen's Houthi movement claimed responsibility for an attack on a Saudi base where an Italian fighter jet was destroyed, denying conflict with Italy but accusing Italy of supporting Saudi Arabia. The Washington Post reported the Pentagon concealed casualty figures for U.S. military personnel in the Middle East.

stories.title: Seda vince l’European Carton Excellence Award 2026 con un nuovo imballaggio

en.title: Seda wins European Carton Excellence Award 2026 with new packaging
en.summary: Seda International Packaging Group won the Food category of the European Carton Excellence Award 2026 with an innovative cardboard packaging solution called Da Vinci Clamshell for food service.

stories.title: Chimica e farmaceutica lanciano un’analsul lavoro e la svolta tecnologica

en.title: Chemistry and pharmaceuticals launch analysis on work and technological shift
en.summary: The chemistry and pharmaceutical sectors are conducting a study through the University of Milan to examine labor developments and technological changes, with results informing future industrial relations discussions.

stories.title: Sanlorenzo: «Con Swan integrazione chiusa molto positivamente»

en.title: Sanlorenzo: Swan integration closure very positive
en.summary: Sanlorenzo reports positive completion of the Swan integration, with activity continuing at the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda during the 23rd Rolex Swan Cup regatta.

stories.title: Meccanica, Stm accelera sul mercato inglese

en.title: Mechanics, Stm accelerates in the English market
en.summary: Stm, a Bologna-based reducer and geared motor manufacturer, is expanding its UK presence beyond its current commercial operations with new market development plans.

stories.title: Biomedicale, da Palermo la rete delle competenze

en.title: Biomedical, competence network from Palermo
en.summary: Twenty new biomedical and biotech laboratories have opened in Palermo, creating an integrated network connecting education, industry, research, and healthcare systems.
